items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Jean Goldkette, they worked at the Greystone Ballroom and Jean Goldkette managed them, too.

ctx.x: What happened to Prince? Why didn't he (inaudible)?

I don't know. Sometimes it happens because -- and it was like -- now Jean Goldkette, they worked at the Greystone Ballroom and Jean Goldkette managed them, too. So they were the black band that played and whenever Jean Goldkette went out, they went out. So there was no need. I don't know why he didn't get the recognition because he was on the scene and there were people coming out of Fletcher's band like they used to go out of Whiteman's to Goldkette. They used to do that, you know. And they were doing that with…

But he just never -- he never captured the recognition that he should have gotten and of course, you know, like in the years he started declining, styles and things change, you know, people forgot all about him. But Hawk liked him, too. He said a lot of nice things about -- I mean, even to me.
